title: 3 Claude Code Hacks to Stop Hitting Usage Limits
description:
Comment HACK and I'll send you the full list of Claude Code commands.

Three hacks to stop Claude Code from hitting usage limits 👇

Set up your model so Claude uses Opus 4.7 only for planning and Sonnet 4.6 for everything else — saves quota without losing quality on the hard thinking. When your conversation gets long, compress the full chat history into a tight summary and keep working with the same context. And add a deep-reasoning trigger at the end of any complex prompt to push Claude into much deeper thinking before it writes any code.

#ClaudeCode #AIcoding #Anthropic #DeveloperTools #AItools
